gloss: out of office; not in power; independent

definitions.gloss: out of office; in opposition; not in power
definitions.explanation: Being outside the ruling party or government. Used in politics to describe parties or politicians who are not currently in power.
Being outside of official or institutional organizations. Used for scholars, researchers, or professionals who work independently rather than within established institutions.

examples.english: They lost the election and went into opposition.

notes:
Literally means "being in the field" — i.e., among the common people rather than in the halls of power. Composed of {在|ざい} (being at) and {野|や} (field, the wild). The contrast is with ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧ (ruling party) in politics, or with institutional affiliation in academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在野|ざいや}⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: opposition party
- {在野|ざいや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧: to go into opposition; to lose power
- {在野|ざいや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧: independent researcher
- {在野|ざいや}⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: spirit of independence (from established power)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: opposition party — the standard political term, more common
- ⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧: private sector; civilian — broader, not specifically about opposition
- ⟦{無所属|むしょぞく}→無所属：13583_mushozoku⟧: unaffiliated; independent — specifically about organizational membership
- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧: ruling party
- {官|かん}: government; official sector
